title: Fault Lines, episode #9 – Raj Singh – Inside JLL Spark: Investing Beyond Real Estate
summary: Augustin Sayer, Managing Partner of OVNI Capital, sits down with Raj Singh, Managing Partner of JLL Spark, to explore an unconventional career spanning IBM, venture capital, entrepreneurship, and corporate venture investing.
